recipe.role: independent diagnostic; never training or delay calibration

position_derivatives.edge_policy: exclude half-window at record boundaries; no differentiation across gaps >40ms

plateau_checks: encoder displacement divided by elapsed time
trapezoidal integral of reported velocity against encoder displacement
unshifted raw velocity and fixed-window position derivatives
recipe.raw_can_matching: latest preceding kernel RX per joint; report ages and disagreement, never shift
recipe.uncertainty: method sensitivity and quantization bounds, not calibrated physical confidence intervals
recipe.latency: do not estimate, fit or apply any new time shift on these independent data
recipe.static_analysis: last 8s of initial/final settle; all 7 feedback channels

can.timestamp: Linux kernel software RX; device acquisition timestamp unavailable

can_health.timestamp_kind: Linux kernel software receive; not device acquisition

bridge_command_check.meaning: bridge input follows native target; packet encoding reconstructed, physical TX not independently observed

temperature.label_scope: initial condition only; temperature may change during capture
temperature.observation_source: passive CAN feedback nominal MOS/rotor Celsius; validity recorded per sample
temperature.timestamp_kind: Linux kernel software receive; not device acquisition

metadata.time_source: ROS header ns; recorder watchdog monotonic

limitations: Unloaded/no contact is operator declaration, no independent wrench sensor
No external encoder or acquisition timestamp; feedback consistency is not physical calibration
Centered SG is acausal offline analysis; peak values depend on window and attenuation
Quantization bounds exclude mechanical dynamics, model error and filtering bias
No new lag fit, model changes, controller tuning or zero-offset subtraction
Bridge commands are software inputs; no independent evidence of actual CAN TX or motor internal loop timing
